baseline_note: No skill change this iteration - iteration 7 adds test surface: the large bazaar target and the solo-vs-fanout differential that measures the parallel-exploration behavior committed in adff035.

ground_truth_files.bazaar: ground_truth_bazaar.json (31 issues after adjudication, 10 traps, 8 clean items)

arms.adjudicate: fanout tools, run against the DRAFT ground truth to validate it before freeze; its findings shaped the corrections, so treat its scores as in-sample
arms.solo: Read Grep Glob only - subagents disallowed
arms.fanout: Read Grep Glob Task Agent - the skill's parallel-exploration cue active; fresh run against the frozen ground truth
arms.v3-g: perfburn regression guard, same skill version

headline: The fan-out differential on the 250-file target: fanout matches or beats solo on quality (strict precision 1.0 vs 0.885, pairwise 0.884 vs 0.862, coverage 7/7 both, cross-subsystem recall 4/4 both, 0 traps both) at 43% of the cost ($4.89 vs $11.18), 78% fewer tokens (3.3M vs 15.3M), and 75% of the wall time (853s vs 1143s). Solo found one more planted issue (recall 0.968 vs 0.935).
known_limitations: One sample per arm; iteration 6 measured ~10% run-to-run noise and an ordering spread of 0.78-0.95 - single-sample deltas within that band are not signal.
The adjudicate arm's scores are in-sample: its findings produced the ground-truth corrections. The solo/fanout arms ran fresh against the frozen GT.

All three designed P4 plants adjudicated down to P2/P3 - the written code offered Small fixes the designs did not anticipate (an existing total_cents column, a schema-preserving frame walk, a Counter-based update). Constructing a true P4 that survives contact with real code is open work; p4_* metrics are currently vacuous (p4_total 0).

Solo produced 3 unmatched P3-grade findings (sequential detail-handler queries, a candidate-row copy, settlement full-table load) pending adjudication review - candidates for future corrections, not counted against precision conclusions.
The perfburn guard again ranked the score_term lru_cache key critique as a P3 finding (the known borderline trap PB-TRAP-3: a real Low/Small design smell that the matrix itself derives to P3).

Impact/tier label accuracy on bazaar (0.52-0.625) is below perfburn levels for both arms - Medium/High boundary judgment at this issue density; the calibration fields in the GT make per-case review cheap.
bazaar tests import a few module paths that do not exactly exist (cosmetic; imports never resolve in the static audit).
